The scorecard

Five findings.
Five fixes.

What the audit found on marbonductsteam.com — and what the agenticrx version does about each one.

🔴 Costing you jobs

No online booking — anywhere

The only contact paths on the homepage are a phone number and an email address. No booking form, no scheduler, no click-to-text. A homeowner who wants a duct cleaning at 10 PM has to wait until someone answers.

The agenticrx fix: one tap in chat → slot offered → name → booked. The owner gets a one-line summary, and the customer gets a confirmation text instantly.
🔴 Costing you trust

The proof doesn't match the claim

The homepage claims 5,000+ Happy Customers — but the site's own structured data shows a 5-star rating based on just 7 reviews. When the proof is seven reviews, the big number invites skepticism instead of trust.

The agenticrx fix: a live review feed on your homepage that grows with every job — verified reviews that keep pace with the claim.
🔴 Costing you trust

The comparison table renders empty

The homepage's "Marbon DuctsTeam vs. Others" table lists rows like "Expert Technicians" and "Transparent Pricing" — with no checkmarks under either column. It reads as an unfinished page, not a winning argument.

The agenticrx fix: a rebuilt page where every claim is complete, checked, and specific — or the table is gone and the reviews do the talking.
🟡 Leaving money on the table

Your hours contradict themselves

The page lists hours as 7 AM–11 PM every day, while the hours widget on the same page reads "Closed · Opens Sun 7AM". A customer checking before a call gets two different answers.

The agenticrx fix: one source of truth for hours, plus an AI that answers the "are you open?" question 24/7 — and books when you're not.
🟡 Leaving money on the table

No recurring-revenue path offered

Duct cleaning is a repeat business — but the page offers no maintenance plan, no annual-cleaning membership, no "remind me next year" option. Every job is a one-time transaction by design.

The agenticrx fix: chat-based plan enrollment after every visit — annual cleanings booked, reminded, and renewed automatically.
